acceptance_criteria.criterion: `InitializeProjectSchema.parse()` accepts objects with a valid `project_summary` string and without `project_summary`.
When `project_summary` is passed to `initializeProject()`, the value is present in `project-ledger.json` after the call.
When `project_summary` is passed to `initializeProject()`, the value is present in `.meta.json` after the call.
When `project_summary` is omitted, neither `project-ledger.json` nor `.meta.json` contain the field.
All existing `initializeProject` tests continue to pass.
